newsitem.title: UK: Licht trims forecast for 1996/97 world sugar outpu.
newsitem.headline: Licht trims forecast for 1996/97 world sugar outpu.

text.p: World sugar production is expected to reach 123.16 million tonnes raw value in 1996/97, slightly lower than the last forecast, German statistician F.O. Licht said in a report on Thursday.
Licht's previous and second estimate of the world 1996/97 sugar balance, issued in February, saw production at 123.28 million tonnes. This compared with 125.86 million tonnes produced in 1995/96.
It raised its production forecast for the European Union (EU) by 1.5 percent, putting 1996/97 output at 18 million tonnes -- one million more than in 1995/96.
Asia was the continent where production was below earlier
